{{Short description|None}}
[[File:South Korea (orthographic projection).svg|thumb|Location of [[South Korea]]]]

[[South Korea]] is a [[sovereign state]] in [[East Asia]], constituting the southern part of the [[Korean Peninsula]].<ref name="CIA">{{CIA World Factbook}}</ref> [[Urbanization by country|Highly urbanized]] at 92%,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.index.go.kr/potal/main/EachDtlPageDetail.do?idx_cd=1200 |script-title=ko:지표상세|work=Index.go.kr|date=July 24, 2015|access-date=June 20, 2016}}</ref> South Koreans lead a distinctive urban lifestyle; half of them live in [[Tower block|high-rises]]<ref>[http://news.donga.com/3/all/20160107/75770649/1 [수도권&#93;‘응팔 아파트’ 만들기 서울시의 이색 도전 : 뉴스 : 동아닷컴]. News.donga.com (January 7, 2016). Retrieved June 20, 2016.</ref> concentrated in the [[Seoul Capital Area]] with 25 million residents<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.index.go.kr/egams/stts/jsp/potal/stts/PO_STTS_IdxMain.jsp?idx_cd=2729|title=Current population of the Seoul National Capital Area |publisher=Statistics Korea}}</ref> and the world's sixth-leading [[global city]]<ref>Institute for Urban Strategies, The Mori Memorials Foundation (2015). ''[https://www.mori-m-foundation.or.jp/english/ius2/gpci2/ Global Power City Index 2015.]'' Retrieved March 2, 2016</ref> with the [[List of cities by GDP|fourth-largest economy]]<ref>[http://www.brookings.edu/research/reports2/2015/01/22-global-metro-monitor Global Metro Monitor |Brookings Institution]. Brookings.edu (January 22, 2015). Retrieved June 20, 2016.</ref> and seventh-most [[sustainable city]] in the world.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.arcadis.com/en/global/our-perspectives/sustainable-cities-index-2016/comparing-cities/|title=Sustainable City Index 2016 - Comparing cities|publisher=[[Arcadis]]}}</ref>

Driven by a [[Programme for International Student Assessment|highly educated]] and skilled workforce, it has the world's [[Developed country#Gallup median household and per-capita income|eighth-highest median household income]], the highest in Asia, and its singles in particular [[Developed country#Net take-home pay of OECD members|earn more than]] all [[G7]] nations. Globally, it ranks highly in [[List of countries by intentional homicide rate|personal safety]],<ref>[https://www.numbeo.com/crime/rankings_by_country.jsp Crime Index by Country 2016]. Numbeo.com. Retrieved June 20, 2016.</ref> [[job security]], and healthcare quality, with the world's [[List of countries by life expectancy|third-highest]] [[Healthy Life Years|health adjusted life expectancy]] and fourth-most efficient healthcare system.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-09-29/u-s-health-care-system-ranks-as-one-of-the-least-efficient|title=U.S. Health-Care System Ranks as One of the Least-Efficient|first=Lisa Du lisadont Wei|last=Lu|date=September 29, 2016|publisher=Bloomberg}}</ref> It is the world's [[List of countries by research and development spending|largest spender on R&D per GDP]], leading the [[OECD]] in graduates in science and engineering<ref name="Business Insider">{{cite web |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/most-technological-countries-lag-behind-in-science-2015-12/#7-estonia-26-has-one-of-the-highest-percentages-of-female-stem-graduates-at-41-in-2012-4 |title=These are the 10 smartest countries in the world when it comes to science |publisher=Business Insider |date=December 4, 2015 |access-date=October 26, 2016}}</ref> and ranking third in the [[Youth]] [[Wellbeing]] Index.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.youthindex.org/reports/globalyouthwellbeingindex.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=2016-11-07 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140417031605/http://www.youthindex.org/reports/globalyouthwellbeingindex.pdf |archive-date=2014-04-17 }}</ref> Home of [[Samsung]], [[POSCO]], [[LG]] and [[Hyundai Motor Group|Hyundai-Kia]], South Korea was named the world's most innovative country in the [[Bloomberg Innovation Index]],<ref name="The Bloomberg Innovation Index">{{cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/graphics/2015-innovative-countries/ |work=Bloomberg |title=The Bloomberg Innovation Index}}</ref> ranking first in [[List of countries by business R&D intensity|business R&D intensity]] and [[World Intellectual Property Indicators|patents filed per GDP]]. As of 2014, it has the world's [[List of countries by average Internet connection speed|fastest Internet speed]] and [[List of countries by smartphone penetration|highest smartphone ownership]], ranking first in [[ICT Development Index|ICT Development]], [[e-Government]]<ref>[http://unpan3.un.org/egovkb/en-us/Reports/UN-E-Government-Survey-2014 UN E-Government Survey 2014]. Unpan3.un.org. Retrieved June 20, 2016.</ref> and [[List of countries by 4G LTE penetration|4G LTE coverage]].

For further information on the types of business entities in this country and their abbreviations, see "[[Types of business entity#Korea, South|Business entities in South Korea]]".
